This does not include vehicles manufactured for off - highway use and designed exclusively for travel on snow or ice, and supported by one or more skis, belts or cleats that utilize an endless belt tread. Unless you qualify for an exemption from registration ,  you cannot take delivery from an authorized dealer until after the ATV is registered.
